text:
PagerDuty Bot: pagerduty: NEW INCIDENT fired for inference-prod-eu (service: inference-api). Incident ID PD-94822. Severity: P1. Trigger: p90 latency spike + 5xx surge. Paging oncall@sre
Anya: acked via PD, I’m taking it. spinning up a bridge (zoom in 60s).
Devon: I’m nearby, will join the bridge and check autoscaler/redis.
Maria: flagged by support — customers reporting timeouts on streaming endpoints, sending customer list now.
PagerDuty Bot: ack recorded: Anya
Anya: quick triage — inbound traffic to eu cluster is ~6x normal for the last 3m, p90 ~3.2s, errors are 502/503 from model-serving frontends.
Devon: can you paste the model-server logs where we see 502s? suspect upstream connection exhaustion.
Maria: paste logs snippet below: 
```
[2026-03-14T11:02:37Z] inference-prod-eu model-server: ERROR: upstream request failed: 502 Bad Gateway
[2026-03-14T11:02:40Z] autoscaler: scale loop skipped: no healthy nodes available
[2026-03-14T11:03:02Z] model-loader: WARN: checkpoint fetch failed: timeout
```
Anya: running quick checks: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model --field-selector=status.phase=Running` — pods return Running but ready replicas 2/6. init containers failing on a subset.
Devon: checked redis metrics: maxclients reached on redis-eu-primary, connections queued. This explains model init blocking for KV cache.
Devon: provisional mitigation: bump redis maxclients and rotate failover to reduce head-of-line.
Devon: commands I ran: 
```
# bumped redis maxclients on the leader config and restarted replica set
redis-cli -h redis-eu CONFIG SET maxclients 10000
kubectl -n infra rollout restart sts/redis-eu
```
Anya: thanks. I’m enabling canary routing to fallback model-quantized variant in us-west for non-sensitive traffic to reduce pressure on eu. Applying route override now.
Anya: policy applied: `route: inference-prod-eu -> fallback_region: us-west; fallback_model: gptq-small; drain_ratio: 0.25`
Maria: customer impact: preliminary — 12 enterprise customers show 10–40% elevated error rates, mostly real-time chat and codegen features. Support notified.
PagerDuty Bot: escalation scheduled: escalate to SRE Lead in 10m if not resolved.
Devon: rolling quick init-script hotfix to skip optional checkpoint when fetch fails (avoids blocking). pushing now.
Devon: hotfix rollout logs:
```

deployment.apps/model-loader patched
Rolling update started for model-loader (eu)
```
Anya: update 11:10Z — ready replicas increasing to 5/6, 5xx errors dropping to ~1.2%. Latency trending down.
Maria: sent interim update to impacted customers explaining mitigation + temporary fallback routing.
Devon: monitoring added: alert for redis.client.connections > 9000 and model.init.failures > 5/min.
Anya: marking incident: investigating -> mitigated in PD for now. I’ll keep monitoring and will revert fallback after stability window. ETA for full recovery 11:20Z.
PagerDuty Bot: incident PD-94822 state changed: acknowledged -> investigating -> mitigated (provisional)
Anya: next steps: follow-up postmortem, include redis tuning, autoscaler config, and model-init resilience. Assigning followup ticket.
SRE Bot: followup task created: SRE-2026-94822 (owner: Anya). Due date: 2026-03-16.
Devon: +1 on postmortem, also recommend adding a probe for checkpoint fetch latency to avoid future init-time stalls.
Maria: support will include customer-facing timeline in the postmortem draft.
Anya: closing loop — handing off to oncall-followup for post-incident docs. Thanks all :heart:
SRE Bot: incident thread archived and follow-up assigned.
